about: Every budget Tycho's perf scripts enforce (limits) and every number its docs show (metrics). The scripts read limits through perf/harness.ts's limits(); `just tycho report` (shared-web/scripts/report.ts) renders metrics into README.md, PLAN.md, and the root README. Budgets apply to the local release build only; production is recorded (root docs/DECISIONS.md, 'Measurement protocol').

ttfpOverBaseline.what: `check`: reference TTFP over perf/baseline.json's, as a fraction

wasmOverBaseline.what: `check`: app wasm (brotli) over the baseline's, as a fraction, unless a perf/budget-notes.md row accepts the size

overlayToleranceMs.what: every cold run: the panel's TTFP, placeholder, and engine-ready rows against the page's own marks

clickToSchemaMs.what: sample click → schema shown, engine warm, reference median

transferFraction.what: bytes of the file transferred before the schema shows, as a fraction (max over runs)

firstRowsMs.what: sample click → first rows painted, reference median

jumpMs.what: scrollbar release at ~90% → real rows, reference median

flingP95Ms.what: top → bottom fling in ~3 s: frame interval p95, worst reference run

flingMaxMs.what: the same fling: longest frame, worst reference run

memoryCapMiB.what: app memory (wasm + live JS heap) after scrolling every row twice

memoryGrowthPerPass.what: app memory growth from the second-to-last pass to the last, as a fraction (a leak grows every pass; a full cache doesn't)

schemaMs.what: drop a ~1 GB Parquet → schema, reference median

firstRowsMs.what: drop a ~1 GB Parquet → first rows, reference median

appDeltaMiB.what: app peak memory, 1 GB file vs 100 MB file

allAgentsDeltaOfSizeDiff.what: every agent's peak memory difference, as a fraction of the two files' size difference

copyDetect.what: negative control: a held copy must read at least this fraction of the file

schemaMs.what: drop a ~1 GB CSV → schema, reference median

firstRowsMs.what: drop a ~1 GB CSV → first rows, reference median

updateGapMs.what: longest gap between row-count updates during the load, worst run

flingP95Ms.what: a fling while the CSV loads: frame interval p95, worst reference run

flingMaxMs.what: the same fling: longest frame, worst reference run

flingP95Ms.what: fling with the panel open and closed: frame interval p95, reference

flingMaxMs.what: the same fling: longest frame, reference

tolerance.what: each panel value against an independent measurement (or half its display step)
